message.content:
VOTE: APPROVE

The draft meets every condition I set in Round 3: oracle-free fixed-λ leads with the triple print and inline power clause (§1.2); the gate is one-sided, own critical value, agenda-only, with the three robustness lines (§2.3); L_R formula with both inequalities audited and a halt on breach (§9); frequency option (b) with the override recorded verbatim, monthly P unscored, spec-governs-code prospective (§3); one-per-onset trigger with sealed replay not conditioned on score (§6); EBP historical test closed (§8). The §11 table gives a defensible reason for each post-hoc choice; I accept it as written. My only veto, O1(c), is not in the text.

Three reservations for the record, none blocking:

1. **§3.2(b) — "the same-origins diagnostic already exists in E2".** It exists only if the m%3==0 months are origin-for-origin identical to the 198 quarterly origins, with identical labels and a shared pooled base rate. That identity is asserted, not shown; 591/3 ≈ 197. The §3.3 sealed monthly spec should include this paired diagnostic on the 2027 panel, with the origin-set identity checked in code, so the −1.02 pp claim is verified rather than inherited. If the sets differ, (b) is not a paired comparison and the minutes should say so.

2. **§8.3 — pre-2027 EBP as fit data.** I asked that no pre-2027 observation be used for fitting or evidence; the text permits fitting under disclosure. With ~8 onsets, fitting on the inspected pattern and scoring on 2 later onsets largely tests whether the inspected pattern recurs — a weaker design than the text implies. Acceptable because any such test is decades away and must be sealed; I note it so a future council does not read §8.3 as a half-open door.

3. **§1.2 power clause.** The ≈150-year figure is derived from the September-only, real-time-censored replay. Once the §6.2 configuration-specific replay exists, the clause should be re-derived from it and labelled "order of magnitude, configuration 2027-09"; the same holds for the Gaussian 2.8·SD approximation behind the ≈30 pp MDE in §2.3, which should be marked as a normal-theory figure.

Post-hoc acceptability, restated: each decision is a tightening, a disclosure, or the status quo with the override on record. Nothing moves P before 2027-09.
message.reasoning:
I'm checking the consensus draft against my Round 3 conditions one by one—confirming N1, N2, and N3 match, and verifying the O1 compromise language on the override and monthly P reporting aligns with what I required.

Now I'm scrutinizing whether the draft's claim about §3.2(b) actually satisfies my sealed diagnostic request. I asked for a paired comparison of the monthly fit scored on the 198 quarterly origins, and the draft points to E2's quarter-thinned score (−1.02 pp gap) as equivalent — but I'm not convinced the thinned months (m%3==0) genuinely line up with the quarterly origins, or that the pooled base rates and labels underlying each score are truly comparable rather than superficially similar.

I'd accept this reading conditionally, flagging that the identity between the thinned set and the quarterly origins needs verification, and that the sealed 2027 diagnostic should still run independently against the actual 2027 panel. On O2, I'm leaning toward accepting the one-per-onset framing but only with conditions — namely that the replay be sealed and published before 2027.

For O3, the draft diverges from my earlier sharpening: I wanted pre-2027 EBP excluded entirely as fit data, but the draft adopts Sol's looser version where it can be used for construction as long as it's disclosed. I'm treating that as a reservation rather than a veto, since I only reserved O1(c) as an actual veto point, and now I want to check how §1.2(iii) frames things.

Checking further: Sol's objection to calling 18.32 an "upper bound" was incorporated, Kimi's wording wasn't, and the renaming in §2.2 of the gate's own MDE as a critical value looks fine. Scanning the remaining sections—§3.2(d), §7, §10.1, §11—nothing jumps out as objectionable, and the "+27.05% never a standalone figure" rule in §1.2 seems fine too, though I want to look closer at the same-origins diagnostic claim in §3.2(b).

I need to flag that the paired claim about m%3==0 months matching the quarterly origin set and shared pooled base rate should be verified against the committed code rather than assumed, and that the 2027 sealed diagnostic structure should be preserved in §3.3's spec since the panel changes. Second reservation: the §8.3 pre-2027 fitting approach effectively fits on the seen onset pattern before evaluating on just 2 post-sealing onsets, so I'd rather see "never as fit data" stated explicitly even if disclosure is accepted as a compromise.

Third reservation concerns §1.2's power clause — the 150-year figure derives specifically from the September-only real-time replay but is presented as applying to the ledger generally, so it needs re-derivation from the §6.2 configuration replay once sealed, with the clause labeled as "order of magnitude." Alternatively, I could flag §2.3's Gaussian assumption in the 80%-power MDE formula instead — I'll go with the power clause issue. I should also confirm post-hoc acceptability per the brief's requirement, noting that §11 already covers this and I'll mark it accepted. Time to write the roughly 350-word response.
